title: Greeting and warning against pride and grumbling
english: To the most reverend brother and papa John, Epiphanius, bishop, sends greetings in the Lord.

We ought not, beloved, to be carried away by the pride of office, but ... For the divine Scripture says: “Do not grumble, as some of them grumbled and were destroyed by the destroyer” (1 Corinthians 10:10, with allusion to 10:9).
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
baehrens: PG Epistula ad Joannem Hierosolymitanum u01-open
orientation: Epiphanius opens his letter to John of Jerusalem with a formal greeting, then immediately warns him not to be carried away by pride of office, citing Scripture against grumbling.
